answers.core: This functionality already exists in Godot for some native methods and would make sense to have especially since the docs recommend a [Custom Scene Switcher](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/scripting/singletons_autoload.html#custom-scene-switcher), which would remove the scene autocomplete.
answers.workaround:
~~This enhancement would change the recommended way of statically typing scene paths so it would be used often.~~
As a workaround, you could have your wrapper function take an enum which maps to a string path name but that has its own problems.

title: User methods to use native autocompletes / editor tooltips for certain arguments like scene paths
